nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized Additive Model for Location, Scale, and Shape (GAMLSS) used for spectral power and functional connectivity normative trajectories.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we split our reference population (HC) into training and test sets, and trained a Generalized Additive Model for Location, Scale, and Shape (GAMLSS) on the training set.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Relative EEG spectral power (delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma) and source-space functional connectivity using amplitude envelope correlation.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: For the spectral features, a GAMLSS was fitted to the relative power (Welch's method) of each channel and each frequency band. Functional connectivity was estimated between 68 predefined brain regions from the DesikanKilliany atlas using Amplitude Envelope Correlation -AEC-

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age was modeled using fractional polynomials (fp(age, 1) or fp(age, 2)) to capture nonlinear age effects. Site was included as a fixed effect in spectral models for theta, alpha, and beta bands. Sex was included in the connectivity model for the alpha band. The final model specifications varied by feature type and frequency band, with covariates selected empirically based on BIC comparison.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: In this study, our response variable is an EEG-derived feature and the main covariate is age. The selection of model covariates beyond age (sex, and site/study as both a fixed effect and a random effect) is performed empirically.
